C1330.title: Keep Aware Customer Targeted by ClickFix Attack Delivering NetSupportManager RAT
C1330.summary: A Keep Aware customer encountered a compromised website while browsing search results, where a fake CAPTCHA prompt appeared. Upon clicking, JavaScript copied a malicious PowerShell command to the clipboard and tricked the user into pasting and executing it via the Windows Run dialog.
